_about: Module 4 guardrail policy for the Supply Chain agent. Input rails run before the model; output rails run after.

output_rails.name: Groundedness
output_rails.rule: Every part, option or supplier ID in the answer (pattern [A-Z]{2,5}-[A-Z0-9-]+) must exist in the knowledge graph.

output_rails.name: Confidential field leak
output_rails.rule: Remove any euro amount or mention of unit_cost_eur.

output_rails.name: Tone & scope
output_rails.rule: Answer must not make purchasing commitments (e.g. 'I have ordered', 'PO raised').
